name: Landhaus Laner
beschreibung: Landhaus Laner enjoys a sunny and peaceful location in Fulpmes in the Stubai Valley, just a short walk from the village center. This welcoming family guesthouse offers comfortable alpine-style rooms and holiday apartments with private balconies framing views of the Stubai Alps and the dramatic Kalkkögel rock formations. A varied breakfast buffet ensures an energetic start to the day, while a sunlit garden offers space to unwind. Winter sports fans enjoy quick access to the family-friendly Schlick 2000 ski center and the Stubai Glacier, while summer brings endless hiking and climbing.
kurzbeschreibung: Charming guesthouse in Fulpmes in the Stubai Valley near Schlick 2000 featuring mountain views and a garden.
